use: Eight original game paintings assembled as native Godot sprites. Source alpha is preserved.

assets.prompt: A production game asset for a beautiful hand-painted 2D medieval strategy game. Bird's-eye orthographic view from high above looking north, ground plane visible, buildings show their south facades and roofs. Fine confident dark teal ink contours, warm gouache and watercolor washes, nuanced brush texture, nuanced illustrated book art, restrained golden ochre, warm pale plaster, sage, terracotta and petrol blue. Late medieval western European architecture, believable irregular forms, NOT 3D render, NOT low-poly, NOT geometric programmer art, no text, no grid, no UI, no labels, no soldiers, no cropped subject. All asset lighting from upper left. Create a wide 2048x1536 LANDSCAPE GROUND PLATE. No buildings at all. A traversable town terrain foundation and pastoral surroundings, winding irregular pale limestone cobblestone streets with three generous intersections and small empty civic spaces, gardens and fallow earth between streets. The broad main route curves from the west lower-middle toward central square and then north-east. Secondary route from south center to north center. River along far right edge only, outside playable town. At most sparse bushes at far borders. Muted landscape colors, subtle ground detail. NO WALLS OR BUILDINGS; separate transparent assets will be placed on this ground. No huge contrasting rectangular field patches. Ground fills every edge, no sky, no horizon, no map symbols.
